summary: The reported defect reproduces at 5cc273a780, but the prepared base already contains the required correction. gpu_execution.evidence: The reported failure occurs in ServerArgs model-source path preparation before worker launch or model execution. The deterministic regression exercises the actual handler and ObjectStorageModel call boundary; GPU execution would not add issue-specific evidence.

remaining_limitations: No credentials or accessible target/draft S3-compatible model repositories were supplied, so real object-store network transfers were not performed; ObjectStorageModel.download_and_get_path was intercepted to measure the exact URIs and call count.

The reported H20 two-node TP=8 PP=2 deployment was not reproduced. The verified behavior is limited to pre-worker metadata preparation and does not qualify distributed serving, model architecture behavior, weight streaming, or semantic accuracy.
